v5.9.16 - Carat-funded race retry
Features --- - Optional setting to spend carats on Alarm Clock race retries when item retries are exhausted - Per-career cap for carat-funded retries (default 5, 0 = unlimited) - Works for mandatory races, Try Again dialogs, Trackblazer, and inline retry buttons
Includes v5.9.15 Discord live status and solver alerts.
